name: RoboDR - Unknown participant burst
description: Unknown DDS participants or a discovery flood on the robot network: reconnaissance or a rogue node. Observe-only: alerts, never responds.
query: event.module : "robodr" and (rule.id : "robot.ros2.unknown_participant" or rule.id : "robot.ros2.discovery_flood") and (not robodr.verification.status : * or robodr.verification.status : "verified")
author: Singularity RD
